name: Nina Clione
source:
"Fufufu, that's right. If this was a video game, then [url=/c124653]she[/url]'d be the last boss."

The principal and chairwoman of Ginran Academy, who is adored by the students. She attended Arianrhod Girls' Academy in Europe. During her time as a student there, she was named a diva. Nina is the creator of "Cadenza," a new kind of fencing using stereoscopic images, along with various equipment and facilities to accommodate it.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.ensemble-game.com/29.otohime/character_nina.html]official website[/url]]
